comments.body: I hate how hard is to pull certain quests in Lisbon but i also think it is a matter of each player... I mean I easily got this quest a few time ago but pulling the Dogon Mask quest was hell even meeting all the requirements. I still cant pull white tiger quest by meeting all the requirement... Used up to 60/70 qmps... My friend got it to pop at the first shot.

comments.author: Me
comments.body: I burned 167(I still remember exactly how many xD)QMP's and 4 SQMP's to get the "Messenger of the white god" quest from Venice when I was working the Ranger job card chain, and I met all the requirements. Sometimes it just happens that way. I remember the total number of QMP's/SQMP's I burned doing the chain as well: 522 QMP/37 SQMP. *shrug* All told, in 3.5 years I've probably used nearly 10k QMP and at least 500 SQMP. That's just part of the business called Adventure.
